webhooks.InventoryMoved.description: InventoryMoved, read from the inventory ledger and POSTed to each active subscription. A 408, 429 or 5xx is retried with back-off; anything else, or the last retry, is dead-lettered and kept.

webhooks.SaleCommitted.description: SaleCommitted, read from the sales ledger and POSTed to each active subscription. A 408, 429 or 5xx is retried with back-off; anything else, or the last retry, is dead-lettered and kept.

DomainEvent.description: The §30.2 event envelope (packages/contracts/src/event.ts). Consumers dedupe on idempotencyKey (§31.1).

payload.description: The event's own payload; each event message names its schema.

Money.description: An amount in whole minor units (e.g. 1050 = ₹10.50) — never a float (packages/contracts/src/money.ts).

Quantity.description: A quantity in the unit's smallest step (e.g. 1234 = 1.234 kg) (packages/contracts/src/quantity.ts).
